nodes.label: IT'S YOURS Toast + N SECURED Tray
nodes.norm_label: it's yours toast + n secured tray
nodes.rationale: SECURED counts captures since leaving base this trip, used purely as session feedback; cars are owned immediately and never lost.

nodes.label: ALL HERDS RESET World Event (Secret spawns, ~5 min)
nodes.norm_label: all herds reset world event (secret spawns, ~5 min)
nodes.rationale: Reset cadence assumed ≈5 min because the countdown started at 4m57s.

nodes.label: Size Tags (TINY/BIG/HUGE/GIANT)
nodes.rationale: Size tags scale value; mapped onto the existing mutation/paint system rather than adding a new stat.

nodes.label: Hold-in-Range Capture (0.6 s)
nodes.rationale: Footage shows near-instant capture when ⚡ ≥ Required; a short 0.6 s hold reads as an action on mobile while keeping the pace.

nodes.label: ProfileStore Mock (DEBUG_MOCK = true)
nodes.rationale: Studio playtests use the mock in Data/Components/Settings.luau so no production saves are touched.
